GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , sat 3 Wide No Cover Mid Field 4 Lengths 800m, Ridden Along Middle Of Track and in best ground Straightening Up , Made Good Ground late and grabbed a minor placing # grabbed placing
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide and without cover throughout the early and middle stages. Near the 200m, was obliged to steady for several strides when awkwardly placed on heels, before shifting in around that runner to obtain clear running.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok a touch Wide early, pressed on to face breeze 2 Lengths off 900m, pushed along a touch turn, joint lead Straightening Up , took narrow lead pasing 200m before joined 100m, headed 50m, kept on strong late # worked early
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced three wide without cover in the early stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay, Eased & Settled Down 6 Lengths 3 Wide , in Two Wide by 850m, Drifted Back to 11 Lengths Two Wide turning, Made Some Ground in Straight # never featured
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: From a wide barrier was eased back to the rear of the field to obtain a position with cover in the early stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay, not bustled early & Settled Down 5.5 Lengths on fence, Drifted Back to 9 Lengths turning, hugged rail turning, steered into clear running Straightening Up and Made Ground along rail in straight. [Stewards: Underwent pre-race vet exam.. Passed fit to start.] # never left fence
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 300m, was directed in around heels to obtain clear running.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down last 9 Lengths Two Wide , Drifted Back to 12 Lengths Two Wide turning, Made Some Ground in straight. [Stewards: Post-race vet exam revealed it to be lame in the right hindleg. Vet clearance required.] # Pulled up lame.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: A post-race veterinary examination revealed the mare to be lame in the right hindleg (2/5). Trainer was advised a veterinary clearance would be required prior to the mare's next trial or race start. Cleared.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 2.5 Lengths Two Wide , Drifted Back to 6 Lengths Two Wide turning, Held Ground in straight. [Stewards questioned rider re performance. Jockey stated it was under pressure from 800m and continually ground its way to the line. He added he believed it would appreciate the addition of blinkers or alternatively a step-up in distance. Post-race vet exam did not reveal any abnormality.] # Had Every Chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned, jockey stated that his mount was under pressure from the 800m and continually ground its way to the line. Rider stated that he believed his mount would appreciate the addition of blinkers to its race gear or, on the alternative, a step up in distance. A post-race veterinary examination of the mare did not reveal any abnormality.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped only fairly & Settled Down 5.5 Lengths Two Wide , maintained 5th place (tearaway leader) to 7.5 Lengths turning, shifted wider Straightening Up and Made Some Ground to the line # battled on fairly

Away evenly. Pushed fwd & raced close 2nd Two Wide early . Stayed @ leader's girth midrace & pushed to quicken & carried out =lead Four Wide on home turn. Pressured Four Wide @ 250m & fought on soundly in last 200m. Coming again on line. # On-pace/tried hard.
Jumped ok Settled Down Just Off Mid-Field fence 5 Lengths (1000m), closer 600 field bunching, Straightened Up needing room, Under Whip 300 Clear now made Ground # closed when clear
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Had difficulty obtaining clear running between the 300m and the 200m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Blundered on jumping, Settled Down 2nd Two Wide trailing a half length, allowed to be crossed at the 850m then held together much same to turn 2 Lengths Two Wide , hit Lead 200m and kept going to post # solid win

jumped awkwardly & bumped @ start. Not pushed early & raced Mid Field Two Wide (4L from lead). Improved 1 length midrace & 3 Wide @ 550m. Improving Four Wide (2L from lead) on home turn. Pressured & bumped Five Wide @ 250m. Hit top @ 100m & ran on well late. # Ran on well/missed
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly and shifted in, making contact with a runner. Near the 300m shifted in and bumped a runner.
